description: MUTATES KnowledgeOwl data: creates a new article. KnowledgeOwl API: POST /article.json (JSON). Required by the API: project_id, name, status, url_hash, visibility, and current_version (a nested object `{ <lang>: { title, body, ... } }` — pass it via the `fields` passthrough). Returns the created article.

fields.description: Additional documented KnowledgeOwl fields to send in the JSON write body (e.g. current_version, body) — merged OVER the typed fields above.

project_id.description: The knowledge base (project) id this article belongs to (required).

name: create_article
title: Create an article
